161789: A veteran player who has top class combat ability. He defeats the last boss in the online game "The New Gate" and releases tens of thousands of players that had been trapped inside.
248079: A High Elf and Shin's first support character, Schnee is an NPC from the Game Era. Currently, she is the acting manager of the Moon Shrine. Created by Shin early in the game, Schnee was modeled by combining Shin's preferences.
249623: Tiera Lucent is an Elf and the salesclerk of the Moon Shrine. An aspiring alchemist, she was expelled from her village at a young age when her hair turned black due to a curse.
